question: Bhanu travels from City A to City B. If Bhanu drives his car at (1)/(4) of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 51 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Bhanu would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed and Time are inversely proportional.

Ratio of Normal Speed to New Speed = 4 : 1

Ratio of Normal Time to New Time = 1 : 4

Difference in time = 4 − 1 = 3 units

Given 3 units = 51 minutes ⇒ 1 unit = 17 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 minutes.**
